title: Novel $\mathcal{N}=2$ higher-spin supercurrents
summary: We study cubic interactions of $\mathcal N=2$ massless integer-spin gauge supermultiplets in harmonic superspace. We construct the complete class of abelian $(\mathbf{s},\mathbf{s_1},\mathbf{s_2})$ cubic vertices with the minimal number of space-time derivatives. Such vertices exist only for $\mathbf{s}\geq \mathbf{s_1}+\mathbf{s_2}$ and universally take the form of the gauge prepotential coupled to the conserved higher-spin supercurrent.
